fusions.name: Decoy Coin
fusions.desc: Flicks a lure that deals 4 damage and has a 25% chance of turning the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cheat's Reveal
fusions.desc: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns it for 1 second. Each hit leaves the target [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Purse
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. For 8 seconds, an escort strikes beside you for 5 every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Loaded Sleeve
fusions.desc: When you strike, you gain 30% critical chance for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You also gain +5% dodge chance.
